name: Processing Status 72 Choice
definition: Specifies the status and the reason of the operation.

AcknowledgedAccepted.name: Acknowledged Accepted
AcknowledgedAccepted.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged by the executing party.

PendingProcessing.name: Pending Processing
PendingProcessing.definition: Instruction is pendingprocessing by the executing party.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Instruction is rejected by the executing party.

Completed.name: Completed
Completed.definition: Instruction has been completed by the executing party.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Status that cannot be reported using one of the available standard status.
